lighting_shading.note: Soft, even lighting with gentle highlights on the door panels and leaves.

value_contrast.note: Bright blue door stands out clearly against the warm orange frame.

color_palette.note: Vibrant blue and orange create a strong, cheerful complementary contrast.

composition_hierarchy.note: Perfectly centered composition draws the eye directly to the wreath.

pose_rhythm.note: Highly symmetrical arrangement creates a calm, welcoming, and balanced feel.
